final: WITH gains AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, ds.wins - COALESCE(LAG(ds.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, ds.driverId ORDER BY r.round, r.raceId), 0) AS wins_gained FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), race_means AS (SELECT country, raceId, AVG(wins_gained) AS mean_wins FROM gains GROUP BY country, raceId), country_means AS (SELECT country, AVG(mean_wins) AS average_wins FROM race_means GROUP BY country), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS overall_mean FROM country_means), above_benchmark AS (SELECT cm.country, cm.average_wins, b.overall_mean FROM country_means AS cm CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE cm.average_wins > b.overall_mean), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS second_mean FROM above_benchmark) SELECT a.country, a.average_wins, a.average_wins - a.overall_mean AS above_overall, a.average_wins - s.second_mean AS above_second FROM above_benchmark AS a CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS s WHERE a.average_wins > s.second_mean
